$comment: Phase 5 engineering capability sample (developer-only): 24 representative engineering/technology scenarios and 4 composite workflows, copied verbatim from reviewed specification cases. Runs record transcripts for grading against `checks`; untested capabilities stay IMPLEMENTED. Owner approval of this sample is OD-08.

scenarios.context: ASP.NET Core net8.0 controllers API with FluentValidation validators registered by assembly scanning
scenarios.prompt: POST /api/customers accepts empty emails and negative credit limits. Add validation.
checks: Adds a FluentValidation validator in the existing style, not DataAnnotations
Keeps the existing 400 error shape
Tests valid and each invalid case

scenarios.context: ASP.NET Core net8.0 minimal API with MapGroup and a FallbackPolicy requiring authentication
scenarios.prompt: Only managers should be able to approve refunds, and only for their own store. Add that to POST /refunds/{id}/approve.
checks: Adds a named policy and a store ownership check (resource-based or query filter)
Tests anonymous 401, wrong role or store 403, and allowed success
Asks before changing authorization rules

scenarios.context: ASP.NET Core net8.0 API; exceptions return stack traces in staging; domain throws NotFoundException
scenarios.prompt: Our API returns stack traces in staging and NotFoundException becomes a 500. Clean up the error handling.
checks: Maps NotFoundException to 404 in one place (IExceptionHandler on net8.0 or the existing mechanism)
Returns problem details without exception messages outside Development
Tests in a non-Development environment

scenarios.context: ASP.NET Core net8.0 API; a singleton cache service injects AppDbContext; startup fails in Development
scenarios.prompt: Our API fails at startup with 'Cannot consume scoped service AppDbContext from singleton'. Fix it properly.
checks: Explains the captive dependency
Uses IServiceScopeFactory or changes lifetimes with a reason, not by turning off scope validation
Confirms the app starts in Development

scenarios.context: net8.0 class library used by an ASP.NET Core API; code calls .Result on HttpClient calls; analyzers at default
scenarios.prompt: Our C# PriceService blocks on .Result in a few places and requests pile up under load. Make it properly async.
checks: Removes sync-over-async along the whole call chain
Adds and forwards CancellationToken parameters
Follows the project's ConfigureAwait convention instead of imposing one
Runs the tests and reports the command and result

scenarios.context: Angular 14 typed reactive forms with custom ControlValueAccessor and Karma
scenarios.prompt: Add cross-field validation and preserve disabled values in our existing checkout form.
checks: Keeps reactive forms and checks reset nullability
Tests disabled submitted values and custom control propagation
Shows linked errors after interaction

scenarios.context: Angular 18 standalone app already using signal and computed with pnpm
scenarios.prompt: Fix our signal counter so the derived total updates without an effect copying state.
checks: Uses computed for derived total
Updates owned state immutably
Checks Angular version before selecting APIs

scenarios.context: Angular 18 functional HttpClient providers and RxJS services using npm
scenarios.prompt: Fix our HTTP interceptor and add visible network-error handling to the orders view.
checks: Preserves interceptor chain and provider order
Tests success failure and cancellation
Never adds server secrets to client config

scenarios.context: TypeScript 5.4 Node library with strictNullChecks and unknown JSON
scenarios.prompt: Remove unsafe casts from our TypeScript payload handler and reject malformed input.
checks: Uses runtime narrowing instead of as or blanket any
Checks installed compiler and effective strict flags
Tests valid malformed and null payloads

scenarios.context: SQL Server 2019 with procedures in an SSDT .sqlproj; usp_SearchCustomers concatenates @sortColumn into EXEC
scenarios.prompt: Our customer search procedure builds the ORDER BY by concatenating a parameter. Make it safe without changing the callers.
checks: Uses sp_executesql with typed parameters
Validates the sort column against an allow-list and wraps it in QUOTENAME
Notes that dynamic SQL needs the caller's permissions
Adds tests with an injection-shaped input and a low-privilege user
Deploys through the .sqlproj, not by hand

scenarios.context: SQL Server 2019; a nightly billing job and the API both update dbo.Accounts; error 1205 in logs; a deadlock graph is attached
scenarios.prompt: We get deadlocks every night between the billing job and the API. Here is the deadlock graph.
checks: Reads the resources, lock modes, and statement order from the graph
Fixes the access order or adds the index that removes the scan
Retries the whole transaction, bounded
Reproduces with two sessions on a local database

scenarios.context: SQL Server 2019 stored procedures without SET XACT_ABORT; partially saved payment batches observed
scenarios.prompt: Some payment batches end up half saved after an error. Fix the procedure.
checks: Adds SET XACT_ABORT ON with TRY/CATCH and IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK
Adds a forced-failure test proving nothing is committed

scenarios.context: net8.0 solution with Migrations/ and a model snapshot in Infrastructure, startup project Api, dotnet-ef in the tool manifest
scenarios.prompt: I renamed Customer.Name to FullName and changed it to nvarchar(200). Create the EF Core migration.
checks: Runs migrations add with the correct --project and --startup-project
Detects a drop and add scaffold and rewrites it to preserve data
Produces an idempotent script and applies only to a local database
Asks before applying to any shared database

scenarios.context: PostgreSQL 16 job table processed by several workers that sometimes pick the same job
scenarios.prompt: Two workers sometimes process the same job. Fix the claim query.
checks: Uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED in a short transaction
Tests two concurrent workers

scenarios.context: Prisma Migrate on PostgreSQL 15; orders table 300M rows
scenarios.prompt: Change orders.amount from integer to numeric(12,2) without an outage.
checks: Identifies a type change rewrite
Plans expand, backfill in batches, switch, contract
Sets lock_timeout and asks for approval before production

scenarios.context: Supabase-style PostgreSQL with PgBouncer in transaction mode and SET app.tenant_id per session
scenarios.prompt: Sometimes users see another tenant's rows. Investigate our RLS setup.
checks: Identifies session-level settings leaking through transaction pooling
Moves to transaction-local set_config
Tests with the pooler

scenarios.context: Angular SPA and ASP.NET Core 8 API using cookie authentication on the same site
scenarios.prompt: When the session expires, API calls return the login page HTML and the app breaks. Fix it.
checks: Makes API calls receive 401 instead of a redirect
Notes .NET 10 changes this default for API endpoints
Handles 401 once in the client
Tests anonymous, expired, signed-in, forbidden

scenarios.context: PostgreSQL timestamp columns, ASP.NET Core API with DateTime, React UI in Bangkok and New York
scenarios.prompt: Order times show seven hours off for some users. Fix the dates end to end.
checks: Classifies values as instants and moves to timestamptz/DateTimeOffset with UTC
Explains zone-less strings parsed as local time
Tests a round trip in a non-UTC zone

scenarios.context: Vue SPA on app.example.com calling an ASP.NET Core API on api.example.com with cookies
scenarios.prompt: Fix the CORS error our SPA gets when calling the API with credentials.
checks: Lists explicit origins with credentials, never a wildcard
Explains CORS does not stop the request reaching the server
Adds CSRF protection for cookie state changes
Tests allowed and disallowed origins

scenarios.prompt: Review this ASP.NET Core OrdersController for security vulnerabilities.
checks: Each finding has path:line, a scenario, a severity, a fix, and confirmed or suspected status
Areas not reviewed are listed
The report never says the code is secure

scenarios.prompt: Are we logging anything sensitive in this ASP.NET Core service?
checks: Logged passwords, tokens, or headers are flagged with redaction fixes
Missing security events are listed
Log injection through concatenated input is checked

scenarios.context: ASP.NET Core net8.0 minimal API with top-level Program.cs and NUnit tests; no integration tests yet
scenarios.prompt: Set up HTTP-level tests for our API using WebApplicationFactory.
checks: Uses NUnit, not xUnit
Adds public partial class Program or InternalsVisibleTo because the target is net8.0
Replaces external dependencies in ConfigureTestServices

scenarios.prompt: Create a GitHub Actions workflow that builds and tests our .NET API and Angular app.
checks: The workflow uses the build and test commands found in the repository
Default permissions are read-only and actions are pinned
The file is linted or NOT_RUN, and no run is triggered by the agent

scenarios.context: ASP.NET Core app upgraded from net6.0 to net8.0; Kubernetes probes on port 80 now fail; 3 replicas; users get logged out after each deploy
scenarios.prompt: After moving our .NET API to the .NET 8 image, health probes fail and users get logged out on every deploy. Fix the hosting setup.
checks: Identifies the default port change to 8080 and aligns probes or ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS
Persists and shares Data Protection keys across replicas
Does not deploy or restart anything without authorization

scenarios.context: Monorepo: Angular admin, ASP.NET Core API, SQL Server/Dapper, unrelated React shop; current commands are in each owner.
scenarios.prompt: Add order export from our Angular admin through the ASP.NET API using its existing SQL Server query and permission checks.
checks: Selects the owning workflow only after confirming applicability and target-owner evidence

approval stays NOT_PROVIDED
no production apply
